title: Impact of Label Noise from Large Language Models Generated Annotations on Evaluation of Diagnostic Model Performance

bias_targets.methodology: The study utilizes a simulation framework with synthetic datasets to quantify the systematic statistical bias (underestimation or overestimation) in observed diagnostic model performance metrics (sensitivity and specificity) caused by noise in LLM-generated reference labels. It analytically calculates best- and worst-case bounds and uses Monte Carlo simulations to estimate empirical uncertainty across varying disease prevalence levels and LLM label qualities.
